answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, released only after three unrelated confirmations, no identity may audit its own recruit. A jetty of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ocean of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the dune is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
